name: Leonida Classic Rock Radio
summary: High-octane southern rock, heartland anthems, and classic hard rock station celebrating legendary guitars and highway driving across rural Leonida.
description: Broadcasting from the outskirts of Mount Kalaga down through the rural bayous of Ambrosia, Leonida Classic Rock Radio is the definitive soundtrack to highway road trips and off-road truck rallies. Home to Tom Petty's catalog, classic southern blues riffs, and gritty rock anthems, the station captures the rugged frontier spirit of the state.
genre: Southern Rock, Classic Rock, Heartland Rock
